retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a performer against a desaturated flag background with layered script and serif typography.
triggerTerms: hip hop artist with flag background

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic low-angle portrait of a male artist singing into a microphone, set against a faded, semi-transparent American flag. The composition uses a dark foreground figure to create depth against a bright, hazy background, anchored by a large, stylized script title in the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in dark clothing contrasting with a bright, desaturated background
Diagonal body positioning creating a sense of movement and energy
Layered typography with a small serif header and a large script footer
Symbolic background elements like stars and stripes integrated into the atmosphere
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the subject's face and hands
Desaturated color palette with dominant blues and whites
A mix of formal serif and expressive script fonts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, leaning diagonally from the top right toward the center, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large script title at the bottom serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the artist's body from the top right down to the microphone and then to the large script text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant contains the most negative space, occupied by the hazy flag pattern.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in the subject's clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright whites and light grays in the background and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and blue tones within the flag and the title's drop shadow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a wide-tracked slab serif and a heavy, slanted formal script.
letterConstructionRules: Header: All-caps, high-contrast slab serif with wide tracking.
Title: Thick-stroke script with connected lowercase and ornate uppercase swashes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'A' and 'D' feature extended flourishes that wrap around adjacent letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, authoritative serif and a fluid, personal script.
graphicDevices: Halftone star pattern at the bottom edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, slab-serif feel of the header.
Provides the ornate, formal script quality for the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photo of a male performer in a black durag and shirt, singing into a microphone. The background should be a desaturated, hazy American flag with a bright light source from the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name at the top in a wide-tracked slab serif. Add the main title at the bottom in a large, bold script with a white fill and a thick dark blue outline, slightly overlapping the subject.

verificationChecks: Does the script text have a thick outline?

mustRedesign: Do not copy specific brand logos

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between header and title

postGenerationChecks: Check for legible text against the background
Ensure the halftone pattern at the bottom is subtle
Verify the diagonal composition feels balanced
Confirm the color palette remains desaturated
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Desaturated National Symbol + (Slab Serif Header / Bold Script Title)
